latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release – introduces compliance assistance for in-house legal teams on privacy regulation, DPA review, and data subject request handling.

- Covers GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and several international privacy laws.
- Provides detailed DPA review checklist, including processor obligations and international transfer requirements.
- Summarizes legal touchpoints for in-house teams, including response timelines and breach notification best practices.
- Offers guidance for use during common compliance workflows while stressing that legal determinations require professional review.
